items.title: Visual Impact Analysis Finds Limited Visibility from Nearby Homes and Roads
items.summary: Bethune Energy commissioned a visual impact analysis which found that existing vegetation and the facility’s setbacks from surrounding properties would screen most of the Project from nearby homes and public roads, with potential views generally limited to the upper portions of its tallest structures.
